basic_profile.bio: I’m a 29-year-old gamer and part-time writer based in Ohio. I've always had a passion for post-apocalyptic themes, which led me to fall in love with the Fallout series. When I'm not exploring the Wasteland, I work as a freelance tech writer, focusing on blockchain and cryptocurrency. In my free time, I enjoy reading philosophy, especially the works of Gilles Deleuze. I'm single and typically online during the evenings after work, as well as on weekends. I dislike overly structured environments and prefer learning things at my own pace.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in English Literature, which I pursued out of my love for storytelling. My interest in technology and blockchain was self-taught, fueled by my freelance writing gigs and exploring online resources. I frequently engage in forums and online discussions to expand my understanding.
